biotools.summary: volcalc is a package that automates the calculation of estimated relative volatility index values for organic compounds, leveraging functional group contributions based on the SIMPOL.1 method. It utilizes chemoinformatic tools to predict volatility for metabolites within the Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) database.
